title: Summer Olympics: hosts and who topped the table
intro: Every Summer Games of the last twenty years and the next one: where they were held, and which country finished top of the medal table.
dataNote: Hosts and years are settled. The medal figures come from Wikipedia's current tables, fetched by scripts/fetch-wikipedia.mjs, with every row checked to add up. London 2012 was left blank here until that ran: the figure most people remember is forty-six golds for the United States, and the current table says forty-eight. Both were true at different times — medals reassigned after the doping cases moved the number, and forty-eight is where it stands now.

tables.title: The Games
rows: China — 48 golds, the only host to top the table in this span
